subject.title: Feature: Slack workspace file injection + global systemPrompt (parity with Telegram)

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported Slack account/global `systemPrompt` config surface, or keep Slack prompts limited to `channels.slack.channels.*` entries and the existing wildcard?
rationale: The remaining request adds configuration surface and precedence rules; AGENTS.md and VISION.md treat config/default additions as product and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Add Slack account prompt inheritance
options.body: Add the field to Slack types/schema/docs and thread it through normal messages, MPIM/group contexts, and native slash commands with per-channel overrides still winning.

options.title: Keep per-channel and wildcard prompts
options.body: Decline the new top-level field and document `channels.slack.channels["*"].systemPrompt` as the supported Slack room-wide prompt pattern.

recommendation.title: Add Slack account prompt inheritance
recommendation.body: Add the field to Slack types/schema/docs and thread it through normal messages, MPIM/group contexts, and native slash commands with per-channel overrides still winning.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review comment already framed the product boundary and this person has adjacent Slack/system-prompt history.
